# Single-Cell RNA-seq and Cell-Type eQTL Validation Contract

## Simulation Truth

- Donor genotypes, cell-type/state proportions, cell identities, pseudotime,
  condition and batch labels, donor effects, dropout/library-depth settings,
  marker genes, cell-type eQTL effects, and seed.

## Required Results

- Sparse count matrix, barcodes, feature table, cell/donor metadata,
  pseudobulk matrices, marker/eQTL truth, eQTL results/metrics, and an RDS or
  interoperable matrix representation.

## Required Figures

- UMAP/PCA coloured by cell type, donor, condition, and batch.
- Library-size and zero-fraction/dropout plots.
- Marker-expression or cell-type composition plot.
- Donor-aware pseudobulk heatmap and cell-type eQTL recovery plot.

## Pass Criteria

- Matrix dimensions agree with barcode and feature tables; counts are
  non-negative integers.
- Every cell has a valid donor, cell type, and batch/condition label when these
  were requested.
- Pseudobulk replicates aggregate biological donors, not cells treated as independent samples.
- Marker and eQTL recovery are assessed against retained truth by cell type;
  embedding separation is descriptive, not proof of biological validity.
